DEAD.description: Cognitive and autonomous adoption unreachable. Probabilities are strictly bounded below thresholds.

COGNITIVE-ACCESSIBLE.description: High p_base households can enter LLM routing independently. Median households require social influence (SIR) to trigger cognitive evaluation. Autonomous adoption reserved for high p_base + high SIR.

BROAD-AUTONOMOUS.description: Large fraction of households can immediately adopt due to low upper threshold.

RUNAWAY.description: Adoption cascades almost unconditionally independent of meaningful heterogeneity.
